limitations: One sequential pair, not a cold/warm randomized comparison.
A full-file checksum precedes the first process; no checksum between them.
Fresh processes exclude application KV and session caches; OS caches and other apps remain uncontrolled.
First nonwhite stdout includes loading and prefill; not an exact token callback.
A time difference alone cannot measure page-cache residency or establish why it changed.
Page-in/fault maxima are sampled before exit, not physical SSD byte totals.
This IQ2_XXS 70B model is quantized; original BF16 studies are separate.
